name: opencrabs
title_zh: 一个住在终端里的全栈自主 AI 代理
tagline_zh: 从落地页到后端、文件管理到深度研究，它自己规划、自己修错、自己排程。TUI、CLI、守护进程三合一。
tagline_en: From landing pages to backends, files to deep research—it plans, fixes, and schedules itself. TUI, CLI, daemon in.
desc_en: The all-in-one AI agent living in your terminal. Build landing, mobile apps, backends, manages files, deep research, schedule tasks and events. Self-improving, self-healing, fully autonomous. TUI, CLI and Daemon. Connect to your favorite channels.
why_zh: 不是插件拼盘，是带自我改进循环的常驻代理。它把终端变成操作系统的入口，让 AI 直接驱动你的开发与运维。
why_en: Not a plugin patchwork—a resident agent with a self-improvement loop. It turns the terminal into an OS-level entry point.
limit_zh: 只认终端环境：没有 TTY 或 SSH 会话它就罢工。自主模式会改文件、跑命令，沙箱外慎用。深度研究依赖网络。
limit_en: Terminal-only: no TTY or SSH session, it bails. Autonomous mode edits files and runs commands—use outside a sandbox at your own risk. Deep research.
